comment: The data guards.py reads: your site's generated files and the commands and tools that change what is live. Edit both lists for your site; the starter's entries fit a Cloudflare Worker site. generated: a glob from the repo root and the command that writes it. deploy: a regex for one shell command, where {wrangler} stands for wrangler however it is called (npx wrangler@latest, flags before the verb), the flags that make it local or a dry run (unless), the flags it needs to be remote (only_with), and why it waits for a yes. tools: a regex for an MCP tool's name, with unless_input: a field of its input and the regex that makes it read-only. samples: a known-good and a known-bad case for every rule above, which guards.py --self-test matches as text and never runs. Add a sample with each rule you add.

generated.why: written by your build script; edit its source and run it again

deploy.why: it publishes the site: wrangler deploy, versions deploy or pages deploy
wrangler versions upload publishes a version
wrangler rollback puts an older version live
a package script named deploy publishes the site

tools.why: it changes a Cloudflare resource behind the site
a statement that is not one SELECT, PRAGMA or EXPLAIN can write the database

samples.command: pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy dist
npm run build && npm run deploy
wrangler r2 object put assets/hero.avif --file hero.avif
wrangler kv key put flag on --local
echo ok && wrangler secret put SITE_TOKEN
